# Pettifer & Robin Farrow

- [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) — Friend of — [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him · since v2  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home through the woods, chatting with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) along the way. Upon arriving at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she learns from [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). When confronted about his trickery and lying, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) away.
>
> — v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)_

> Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

> During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P60](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0060), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dismisses school early as a monstrous storm approaches, exactly as [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) predicted. She rushes home with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where they shelter with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) through a terrifying 45-minute hail storm that devastates crops and shatters windows. Afterward, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) arrives to report that lightning struck Mr. Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer comfort.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) after the storm kills his parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md). The community assesses the widespread destruction, while [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) revels in the exactness of his storm prediction. Hugh visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to recount the panic at the school and discuss the damage with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P48](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0048), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_

> Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) explains to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the history of his marriage, his quarrel over his parrot [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), and his eventual reconciliation with [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Brierley Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070)_

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) during a meal, sharing stories about [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md). Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) walk to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), where they share food, enjoy the echoes, and go off to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends a lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday trapped at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by severe snowstorms, feeling awkward during visits from Hugh and worrying about her ability to afford her continued studies. Her mood turns around when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) delivers the mail, including news that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) has left her a one-thousand-dollar bequest in her will.
>
